description: Register behind the 'last updated' and 'next update likely' line under each place-page section (roadmap R503). lastUpdated is the edition date of the series as this site holds it, read from the manifest or data file named in editionFrom, or from the publisher's page where no manifest records it. next is the publisher's own statement of its next release, quoted, with the page and the access date; null means the publisher states none, and the page then says 'next release not stated by the publisher'. No date here is estimated. Served as /data/release-calendar.csv.
